tagline: Climate-positive forest products and renewable solutions company
hero_kpi_rationale: 825,000 hectares of certified sustainable forest management represent the group's core and differentiating asset, generating bio-based solutions and carbon sequestration.

kpis.name: Sustainable forest management
kpis.explanation: Hectares of forests under sustainable management, at the core of the company's renewable value chain.
kpis.description: Key asset for the production of renewable bioproducts and carbon sequestration.

kpis.name: Annual carbon sink
kpis.explanation: Tonnes of CO2 absorbed annually by sustainably managed forests.
kpis.description: Positive climate impact measured per hectare of sustainably managed forest.
kpis.signal: 4.7 million tonnes of CO2 sequestered in 2023

kpis.name: Outstanding green bonds
kpis.explanation: Total amount raised through green bonds to finance sustainable projects.
kpis.description: Funding dedicated to eligible green assets: forests, bio-products, hydropower.
kpis.signal: 1.75 billion euros of green bonds issued

kpis.name: Hydropower production
kpis.explanation: Renewable electricity generated through hydropower plants.
kpis.description: Contribution to the group's renewable energy self-sufficiency.

kpis.name: Bio-solutions patents
kpis.explanation: Number of patents held on biomass-based solutions.
kpis.description: Key intangible assets to replace fossil-based materials.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 0.75 EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.792 Bn EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 165.0% in the latest year.

evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced automation
